    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (1LL * result * base) % MOD;
        base = (1LL * base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }

                }
            }
        }
        child[state_to_id[state]][mask] = explore(next_state);
    }
    return state_to_id[state];
